name: 马丁·海因里希·克拉普罗特
bio_short: 德国化学家，被誉为“分析化学之父”。他是那个时代最精确、最严谨的化学分析家，发现了铀（Uranium）、锆（Zirconium）和铈（Cerium）等元素。他习惯用新发现的天体来命名元素（如铀得名于天王星），以彰显其时代意义。
bio_short_en: A German chemist, considered the 'Father of Analytical Chemistry'. He was the most precise and rigorous analyst of his time, discovering Uranium, Zirconium, and Cerium. He had a habit of naming elements after newly discovered celestial bodies (e.g., Uranium after Uranus) to highlight their significance.
